inputs.text: The IOC is presenting its ban on transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games as a matter of “fairness and safety.” That sounds less like a neutral safeguard and more like a convenient justification for tightening control over who gets to compete—and for making a political decision look inevitable. When Kirsty Coventry says, “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category,” the certainty of the wording does the work: it closes down debate while the institution gets to define the terms. Don’t assume the official explanation tells you whose interests this decision really serves.
